author: CMS-HGCAL
body: #### PR description: In a few commissioning runs we have noticed spurious values filling the DQM plot which reports counts of error flags. This is tracked down to events where the event is not complete (partial payload missing) and uninitialized SoA values. In addition the higher level error flags (capture block) were not being properly reported in case the inner payload (econ-d) is missing. The PR fixes these two issues. #### PR validation: This has been validated with a commissioning run. | Before | After | |-----|-----| | | |
title: Fixes to HGCAL unpacking step
